calculation_handling.description: If lawfully existing buildings cover more of the lot than the permitted maximum lot coverage, the lawful covered portion becomes the maximum lot coverage for those buildings.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the lot coverage as it lawfully existed, an as-built input.

calculation_handling.description: An addition or extension to such lawfully existing buildings must comply with all other regulations or be authorized by a Section 45 minor variance.

10.5.30.41(1).explanation: If lawfully existing buildings already cover more of the lot than the zone's maximum lot coverage, the lawful covered area becomes the maximum for those buildings.

10.5.30.41(2).explanation: An addition or extension to such buildings must meet all other regulations or get a Section 45 minor variance.
